_readme: Replay-ready payload for places_map_display_v0. Every stop is tier 1 (must see / must eat). Verify place_ids with places_search before use. See SELECTION-METHOD.md.
title: Cleveland — Every Must-See, Ranked (Thu–Sun)
narrative: Rebuilt from the guide's ranking rather than hand-picked: every stop is a MUST SEE or MUST EAT, ordered by source count within each region, then re-sequenced so opening hours actually work. Thursday to Sunday, 34 stops. The weekday of each day is forced by a constraint, not a preference.

days.title: Thursday · Suburbs, Metroparks & Cuyahoga Valley
days.narrative: Thursday, because Holden closes Mondays and Tita Flora's closes Mondays. Everything else outdoors is open daily. Long driving day — start early.

locations.name: Holden Arboretum & Stebbins Gulch
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Stebbins Gulch is guided-access only and must be booked ahead. Closed Mondays.

locations.name: Squire's Castle
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Roofless stone gatehouse, free, dawn to dusk, directly on the road south.

locations.name: Cuyahoga Valley NP — Boston Mill Visitor Center
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Start here for maps and rangers.

locations.name: Brandywine Falls
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Boardwalk to a 65-foot fall. Stairs at both levels — not fully accessible.

locations.name: Virginia Kendall Ledges Overlook
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Best sunset in the national park. Arrive 45 min before sunset.

locations.name: Tita Flora's
locations.notes: Must-eat · Filipino. Highest diner-rated Asian restaurant in the region. Closed Monday.

days.title: Friday · University Circle & the East Side
days.narrative: Friday, and not negotiable — the Dittrick opens Friday and Saturday only, and the art museum runs until 9pm on Fridays.

locations.name: Percy Skuy Collection, Dittrick Medical History Center
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. THE CONSTRAINT THAT SETS THE TRIP: Friday 10:30–4 and Saturday 12–4 only. Free.

locations.name: Lucy, Cleveland Museum of Natural History
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Plus Balto and the Apollo 12 moon rock. Closed Mondays.

locations.name: Superior Phở
locations.notes: Must-eat · TOP-SCORING FOOD, 3 sources. Enter through Golden Plaza, free parking. Closed Monday.

locations.name: Wade Memorial Chapel
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. THE BEST THING NOBODY TELLS YOU ABOUT: a Tiffany interior by an all-female workshop. Daily 10–4, free.

locations.name: Haserot Angel
locations.notes: Must-see · HIGHEST-SOURCED PLACE IN THE GUIDE, 3 sources. Section 9, Lot 14. Nearest landmark: Hanna Mausoleum.

locations.name: Lake View Cemetery — Garfield Memorial & grounds
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Climb the Garfield tower. Gates close 7:30pm Apr–Oct.

locations.name: Cleveland Museum of Art & The Thinker
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 entries. Free, open to 9pm Fridays. The Rodin was bombed in 1970 and never restored.

locations.name: Presti's Bakery
locations.notes: Must-eat · desserts. Century-old Little Italy bakery. Take a number or get cut in line.

locations.name: Quintana's Speakeasy
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Buzzer at the barbershop's back door, then pull the right book. Closed Sun & Mon.

days.title: Saturday · Downtown & The Flats
days.narrative: Saturday, because the chess collection closes Sundays and the Terminal Tower deck opens weekends only. All ten downtown must-sees, ending under the chandelier after dark.

locations.name: Soldiers' & Sailors' Monument
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Free museum. Ask whether the tunnels below are open — roughly one day a year.

locations.name: Chess Collection — Cleveland Public Library MAIN Library
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. 325 Superior Ave NE, third floor — NOT the address News 5 prints. Closed Sundays. Bring photo ID.

locations.name: The Arcade (Old Arcade)
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. 1890, America's first indoor shopping centre.

locations.name: Heinen's Downtown
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. A grocery inside a bank rotunda. Eat lunch on the balcony.

locations.name: Terminal Tower Observation Deck
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Weekends only 12–4, tickets MUST be booked online. Ride to 32, transfer to 42.

locations.name: Hope Memorial Bridge & the Guardians of Traffic
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Eight art deco giants, 43 feet each. Walk it — pedestrian ways both sides.

locations.name: Steamship William G. Mather
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. 618-foot freighter, open stem to stern. Closed Monday, seasonal.

locations.name: Free Stamp
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Rejected by the corporation that commissioned it. Two minutes, always open.

locations.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Open to 8pm Saturdays. Buy ahead. Three hours minimum.

locations.name: Wonton Gourmet & BBQ
locations.notes: Must-eat · Cantonese, 2 sources. Roast duck and char siu in the window. Open to 9:15pm. Closed Tuesday.

locations.name: GE Chandelier, Playhouse Square
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Largest outdoor chandelier in North America. Free, lit nightly. Go after dark.

days.title: Sunday · West Side, Ohio City & Tremont
days.narrative: Sunday, set by the market (10–4) and Buckland (12–4). Ends with sunset on the lake. Two west-side must-sees cannot fit — see README.

locations.name: West Side Market
locations.notes: Must-see · HIGHEST-SOURCED PLACE IN THE GUIDE, 3 sources. Sunday 10–4. Bring cash. Park at the back.

locations.name: Mitchell's Ice Cream, Ohio City
locations.notes: Must-eat · desserts. Made on site in a restored 1920s cinema. Two minutes from the market.

locations.name: Franklin Castle
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Interior is Tuesday-evening tours only — today is an exterior visit.

locations.name: A Christmas Story House & Museum
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Tours every 30 min. Budget two hours, not one.

locations.name: Buckland Museum of Witchcraft & Magick
locations.notes: Must-see · 2 sources. Sunday 12–4 only. Gardner's artifacts and a demon in a box.

locations.name: Barroco Arepa Bar
locations.notes: Must-eat · Latin American, 2 sources. Colombian-Venezuelan. Waits get long and do not shorten.

locations.name: Sweet Moses Soda Fountain
locations.notes: Must-eat · desserts. A 1920s soda fountain rebuilt from scratch. Order the root beer float.

locations.name: Solstice Steps, Lakewood Park
locations.notes: Must-see · 1 source. Best sunset in the region. Arrive 30 min early for a lower terrace.
